simple.meaning: בֵּית פֶּלֶט (Bêyth Peleṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Beth-Palet , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֵּית פֶּלֶט (H1046) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 15:27, with occurrences in Joshua, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּית פֶּלֶט (H1046) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּית פֶּלֶט (H1046) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֵּית פֶּלֶט (Bêyth Peleṭ) / H1046 is traced through Joshua 15:27, Nehemiah 11:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
